interpretation: The original Maps APK requested Android GPS while the board runtime had GNSS disabled. The old adapter reported GPS enabled and previously opened low-power OpenHarmony requests for that provider. The repaired adapter reports GPS disabled and keeps it out of enabled-provider selection. The original APK ran on the matched repair and its explicit GPS subscription reached the disabled-provider path. The host still lacks a configured network-location provider. A physical Maps fix remains unverified.
